python3 - << 'EOF'
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import json

tree = ET.parse('robot.xml')
root = tree.getroot()

# --- Joints ---
joints_data = []
for j in root.findall('.//joint'):
    name = j.get('name')
    jtype = j.get('type', 'hinge')  # default in MuJoCo is hinge
    axis_str = j.get('axis', '0 0 1')
    axis = [float(x) for x in axis_str.split()]
    rng = j.get('range', None)
    ctrlrange = [float(x) for x in rng.split()] if rng else [None, None]
    joints_data.append({'name': name, 'type': jtype, 'axis': axis, 'ctrlrange': ctrlrange})
    print(f"  Joint: {name}, type={jtype}, axis={axis}, range={ctrlrange}")

print(f"\nTotal joints: {len(joints_data)}")

# --- Actuators ---
# Default class 'affine' has ctrlrange="-6.28 6.28"
actuators_data = []
for a in root.findall('.//actuator/*'):
    name = a.get('name')
    joint = a.get('joint')
    cr = a.get('ctrlrange', '-6.28 6.28')
    ctrlrange = [float(x) for x in cr.split()]
    actuators_data.append({'name': name, 'joint': joint, 'ctrlrange': ctrlrange})
    print(f"  Actuator: {name}, joint={joint}, ctrlrange={ctrlrange}")

print(f"\nTotal actuators: {len(actuators_data)}")

# --- Sites ---
sites = root.findall('.//site')
print(f"\nSites: {len(sites)}")
for s in sites:
    print(f"  Site: {s.get('name')}")

# --- Free joints (graspable bodies) ---
free_bodies = []
for body in root.findall('.//body'):
    for child in body:
        if child.tag == 'freejoint':
            free_bodies.append(body.get('name'))
print(f"\nFree-joint bodies: {free_bodies}")

# --- Body tree (leaf bodies) ---
all_body_names = [b.get('name') for b in root.findall('.//body')]
print(f"\nAll bodies: {all_body_names}")

# Leaf bodies = bodies with no child bodies
leaf_bodies = []
for b in root.findall('.//body'):
    children_bodies = b.findall('body')
    if not children_bodies:
        leaf_bodies.append(b.get('name'))
print(f"Leaf bodies: {leaf_bodies}")

EOF
